_meta.formula: A = H(mean beta over the cell's identity loci) / H_min[class(cell)] - RULING A3, the commissioned identity form used by stage_b_identity; betas scale-mapped to the atlas (stage_1s_scale_map) before scoring, as the class gauge does
_meta.scorer: iamatlas_a_scoring._score_one_identity - the chain's own, not a re-implementation
_meta.supersedes_for_scoring: percell_reference_v0_3.json, which is on the MARKER surface and cannot judge identity-surface readings
_meta.design: per laboratory: random disjoint build/held-out split (seed 20260926); band = p10-p90 of A on build; held-out scored against it, nominal in-band 0.80
not_done: fraction conditioning (fraction is a detection gate, author's ruling)

laboratory_offset.what: ONE offset per laboratory, applied to every cell's A as the class gauge applies z_lab. Derived from the per-cell readings: median over the eight present blood cells of (that laboratory's median A for the cell - the four-laboratory median for the cell). One number per laboratory so the per-cell ordering is preserved.
laboratory_offset.agrees_with_class_gauge: sign and order match identity_band_v3 z_lab (UCLA lowest, Karolinska highest)
laboratory_offset.effect: between-laboratory range of per-cell medians: MEDIAN over the eight blood cells 0.0552 -> 0.0073. Not uniform: myeloid cells and B cells agree to 0.003-0.010 after the offset; the lymphoid effectors still carry laboratory disagreement of 0.023 (CD4), 0.014 (CD8) and 0.025 (NK), which one offset per laboratory does not remove.
laboratory_offset.unknown_laboratory: no offset -> A reported as A_raw with lab_offset UNSET; the per-cell A is still shown, its placement is not (fail-closed, as the class gauge)

_meta.percell_centres_note: median over laboratories of (lab median A - lab offset), for every banded cell. A cell's NORMAL is judged against ITS OWN centre - CD4 sits at 1.027 and GMP at 0.960 in every laboratory; a universal ceiling would call healthy CD4 ELEVATED and healthy GMP SUPPRESSED.

percell_centre_hypothesis_test.question: is CD4's +0.027 (and CD8/NK's -0.025..-0.031) heterogeneity of the circulating compartment, or calibration?
percell_centre_hypothesis_test.prediction: heterogeneity: CD4 A rises with age (memory-T accumulation) and with CD4 fraction; CD8/NK the opposite. calibration: flat.
percell_centre_hypothesis_test.reading: NEITHER prediction. A rises with age for EVERY cell at the same slope (+0.005/decade, r 0.46-0.51, all p<2e-5) - that is the commissioned age term c(age), shared, not a per-cell effect. The per-cell ORDERING does not move with age. The only cell-specific signal is with the cell's own fraction, and it is NEGATIVE for CD4 (r -0.576, p 3e-8) and POSITIVE for CD8 (+0.354) and NK (+0.439): the more of a cell there is, the closer its A sits to 1.0. That is the fraction confound PROC-SYNTH-01 measured, from the other direction - a cell's identity loci read the rest of the specimen in proportion to what the cell is not. It is neither biology nor a floor error; it is DETECTION, exactly as the author said: 'it doesnt matter the fraction that is a detection issue'. Consequence: the presence gate per cell should sit where A stops depending on fraction, and the per-cell centre is a property of the cell AT typical healthy fraction.
percell_centre_hypothesis_test.source: 80 published PROC-BAND-01 arrays with ages; GSE87571 series matrix not on disk
